We have identified key candidates: Clover (5WJ2, ex=505) as donor and mCherry (2H5Q, em=610) as acceptor. The SMILES compound appears to be O6-benzylguanine (2-amino-6-benzyloxypurine), which likely binds MGMT (PDB 3KZY). We still need to confirm the molecule binder, identify the antibody target, and get exact cleaned sequences for all components.",
  "plan": "Interrupt any running BLAST, then run a comprehensive Python script to: (1) fetch and parse exact PDB FASTA for 5WJ2, 2H5Q, 3KZY with lengths, (2) get 3KZY ligand details to confirm O6-benzylguanine binding, (3) compare FPbase vs PDB sequences, (4) extract DHFR from plasmid, (5) use NCBI E-utilities to search antibody CDR3 sequences against protein databases for target identification.",
  "commands": [

      "keystrokes": "C-c
",

    {
      "keystrokes": "python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, urllib.parse, json, re, sys, time

# ---- 1. Parse PDB FASTA for key entries ----
print('=== PDB FASTA for key entries ===', flush=True)
key_ids=['5WJ2','2H5Q','3KZY','1AK4','5P21','1KFD','2CHA']
pdb_seqs={}
for pid in key_ids:
    try:
        url=f'https://www.rcsb.org/fasta/entry/{pid}'
        req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
        data=urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15).read().decode('utf-8','replace')
        # Parse all records
        records=[]
        for rec in data.strip().split('>')[1:]:
            lines=rec.split('\n')
            hdr=lines[0]
            seq=''.join(lines[1:])
            records.append((hdr,seq,len(seq)))
        pdb_seqs[pid]=records
        print(f'{pid}:', flush=True)
        for hdr,seq,l in records:
            print(f'  hdr={hdr[:90]}', flush=True)
            print(f'  len={l} seq={seq}', flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{pid} ERR {repr(e)}', flush=True)

# ---- 2. Get 3KZY ligand details ----
print('\n=== 3KZY ligand details ===', flush=True)
for pid in ['3KZY','1AK4','5P21']:
    for eid in range(1,6):
        try:
            url=f'https://data.rcsb.org/rest/v1/core/nonpolymer_entity/{pid}/{eid}'
            req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
            j=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10).read().decode('utf-8','replace'))
            comp_id=j.get('nonpolymer_comp',{}).get('id','')
            comp_name=j.get('chem_comp',{}).get('name','')
            formula=j.get('chem_comp',{}).get('formula','')
            desc=j.get('pdbx_entity_nonpoly',{}).get('name','')
            print(f'{pid} entity {eid}: comp_id={comp_id}, name={comp_name}, desc={desc}, formula={formula}', flush=True)
        except Exception:
            break

# ---- 3. FPbase sequences ----
print('\n=== FPbase sequences ===', flush=True)
url='https://www.fpbase.org/api/proteins/?format=json'
req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
prots=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60).read().decode('utf-8','replace'))
fpbase={}
for p in prots:
    if p.get('slug') in ('clover','mcherry'):
        fpbase[p['slug']]=p
        seq=p.get('seq','')
        print(f"\n{p['name']} ({p['slug']}): pdb={p.get('pdb')}, states={[(s.get('ex_max'),s.get('em_max')) for s in p.get('states',[])]}", flush=True)
        print(f'  len={len(seq)}', flush=True)
        print(f'  seq={seq}', flush=True)

# Compare Clover
if 'clover' in fpbase and '5WJ2' in pdb_seqs:
    fp_seq=fpbase['clover'].get('seq','')
    pdb_seq=pdb_seqs['5WJ2'][0][1]
    print('\n=== Clover comparison ===', flush=True)
    print(f'FPbase len={len(fp_seq)}, PDB len={len(pdb_seq)}', flush=True)
    # Find best alignment
    for i in range(len(pdb_seq)-len(fp_seq)+1):
        mm=sum(1 for a,b in zip(pdb_seq[i:i+len(fp_seq)], fp_seq) if a!=b and a!='X')
        if mm<=3:
            print(f'FPbase matches PDB at offset {i}, mismatches(excluding X)={mm}', flush=True)
            diff=[(j, pdb_seq[i+j], fp_seq[j]) for j in range(min(len(fp_seq),len(pdb_seq)-i)) if pdb_seq[i+j]!=fp_seq[j]]
            print(f'  Differences: {diff}', flush=True)
            break

# Compare mCherry
if 'mcherry' in fpbase and '2H5Q' in pdb_seqs:
    fp_seq=fpbase['mcherry'].get('seq','')
    pdb_seq=pdb_seqs['2H5Q'][0][1]
    print('\n=== mCherry comparison ===', flush=True)
    print(f'FPbase len={len(fp_seq)}, PDB len={len(pdb_seq)}', flush=True)
    mm=sum(1 for a,b in zip(pdb_seq, fp_seq) if a!=b and a!='X')
    diff=[(i, pdb_seq[i], fp_seq[i]) for i in range(min(len(fp_seq),len(pdb_seq))) if pdb_seq[i]!=fp_seq[i]]
    print(f'Mismatches (excluding X)={mm}, diff={diff}', flush=True)

# ---- 4. Extract DHFR ----
print('\n=== DHFR from plasmid ===', flush=True)
gb=open('/app/plasmid.gb').read()
m=re.search(r'/translation="([^"]+)"', gb.replace('\n',' ').replace('  ',' '))
dhfr_full=m.group(1).replace(' ','') if m else ''
print(f'DHFR full: len={len(dhfr_full)}', flush=True)
print(f'  seq={dhfr_full}', flush=True)
dhfr_no_met=dhfr_full[1:] if dhfr_full[0]=='M' else dhfr_full
print(f'DHFR no Met: len={len(dhfr_no_met)}', flush=True)

# ---- 5. Antibody target identification ----
print('\n=== Antibody sequences ===', flush=True)
seqs={}
cur=None
for line in open('/app/antibody.fasta'):
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('>'):
        cur=line[1:].split()[0]
        seqs[cur]=''
    elif cur:
        seqs[cur]+=line
heavy=seqs['heavy']
light=seqs['light']
# Extract variable regions
hv=re.match(r'^(.*?WGQG.{0,10}TVSS)', heavy)
hv_seq=hv.group(1) if hv else heavy[:120]
lv=re.match(r'^(.*?FGGGTKLEI)', light)
lv_seq=lv.group(1) if lv else light[:110]
print(f'Heavy var len={len(hv_seq)}: {hv_seq}', flush=True)
print(f'Light var len={len(lv_seq)}: {lv_seq}', flush=True)

# Extract CDR3s
h_cdr3=re.search(r'(CARE?KFYGYDYWGQG)', heavy)
l_cdr3=re.search(r'(FQGSHVPYTFGGGTKLEI)', light)
print(f'Heavy CDR3 region: {h_cdr3.group(1) if h_cdr3 else "not found"}', flush=True)
print(f'Light CDR3 region: {l_cdr3.group(1) if l_cdr3 else "not found"}', flush=True)

# Search NCBI E-utilities for CDR3 sequences
print('\n=== NCBI ESearch for CDR3 ===', flush=True)
for query in ['"EKFYGYDY"[All Fields] AND antibody', '"EKFYGYDY" AND "heavy chain"', 'EKFYGYDY', '"FQGSHVPYT"']:
    try:
        params={'db':'protein','term':query,'retmode':'json','retmax':5}
        url='https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
        req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
        j=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15).read().decode('utf-8','replace'))
        ids=j.get('esearchresult',{}).get('idlist',[])
        count=j.get('esearchresult',{}).get('count','0')
        print(f'Query: {query} -> count={count}, ids={ids}', flush=True)
        # Fetch summaries
        if ids:
            sparams={'db':'protein','id':','.join(ids[:3]),'retmode':'json'}
            surl='https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(sparams)
            sreq=urllib.request.Request(surl, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
            sj=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(sreq, timeout=15).read().decode('utf-8','replace'))
            for uid in ids[:3]:
                r=sj.get('result',{}).get(uid,{})
                print(f'  {uid}: {r.get("title","")[:120]}', flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Query: {query} -> ERR {repr(e)}', flush=True)

# Also search with full variable region
print('\n=== NCBI ESearch for full variable region ===', flush=True)
for name, seq in [('heavy_var', hv_seq[:50]), ('light_var', lv_seq[:50])]:
    # Use first 50 aa as search term
    query=f'"{seq}"[All Fields]'
    try:
        params={'db':'protein','term':query,'retmode':'json','retmax':5}
        url='https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
        req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
        j=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15).read().decode('utf-8','replace'))
        ids=j.get('esearchresult',{}).get('idlist',[])
        count=j.get('esearchresult',{}).get('count','0')
        print(f'{name} first50: count={count}, ids={ids}', flush=True)
        if ids:
            sparams={'db':'protein','id':','.join(ids[:3]),'retmode':'json'}
            surl='https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(sparams)
            sreq=urllib.request.Request(surl, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
            sj=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(sreq, timeout=15).read().decode('utf-8','replace'))
            for uid in ids[:3]:
                r=sj.get('result',{}).get(uid,{})
                print(f'  {uid}: {r.get("title","")[:120]}', flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{name}: ERR {repr(e)}', flush=True)
PY
